categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文聚焦LLM智能体的自主搜索与协作引导、领域专用模型构建，以及多步推理的正确性评测。

articles.title: AutoNovo: Agentic Program Search Discovers Transferable Nucleic Acid Design Algorithms
articles.zh: AutoNovo：智能体程序搜索发现可迁移的核酸设计算法
articles.summary: 如果你在做核酸/RNA设计，这套让agent自己搜算法的思路，可能比手工调启发式规则更省事、还更能迁移
articles.author: Joel Shor, Subhashini Venugopalan
articles.body: In-silico optimization of nucleic acids relies on predictive oracles that imperfectly capture biological function, so sequences optimized against one model may exploit model-specific artifacts and fail to generalize to independent models. Recent studies have shown that not all designers generalize equally well to independent models. In this work, we use agentic program search to iteratively propose, execute, evaluate, and revise code for nucleic-acid designers. We describe the successful strategies used to prompt the search. AutoNovo designers achieved the best observed mean among the evaluated methods on 3/3 DNA-design tasks in terms of in-silico performance, and 6/6 transfer tasks in terms of independent models. The designers come from a family of discovered nucleic acid designers rather than a single universal best designer. We plan to release the resulting designers. These results are the first steps in creating nucleic acid designers that maximize cross-model generalization, and thus improving the odds that in-silico designed sequences reflect real biology.
articles.bodyZh: 用计算机模拟（in-silico）来优化核酸（nucleic acids），靠的是一些预测模型（predictive oracles）。可这些模型并不能完美还原真实的生物功能（biological function），所以针对某一个模型优化出来的序列，可能钻了模型特有伪影（model-specific artifacts）的空子，一放到独立模型（independent models）上就不灵了。最近的研究也发现，不是所有设计器（designers）都能同样好地泛化（generalize）到独立模型上。在这项工作里，我们用智能体程序搜索（agentic program search），反复提出、运行、评估和修改核酸设计器（nucleic-acid designers）的代码。我们也介绍了用来引导这次搜索的成功提示策略。就计算机模拟表现来说，AutoNovo 设计器在 3/3 个 DNA 设计任务（DNA-design tasks）上，拿到了被评估方法里观察到的最高平均成绩；就独立模型表现来说，它在 6/6 个迁移任务（transfer tasks）上也是如此。这些设计器不是某个唯一通用的最佳设计器，而是来自一族被发现的核酸设计器。我们计划发布最终得到的设计器。这些结果是迈向创建能最大化跨模型泛化（cross-model generalization）的核酸设计器的第一步，也因此提高了计算机模拟设计出的序列能反映真实生物学的可能性。

articles.title: Learning to GUIDE the Group: Self-Learning LLM Facilitation Across Multi-Party Tasks
articles.zh: 学会引导群体：跨多方可任务的自学习LLM引导能力
articles.summary: 如果你想让LLM主持多人协作而不是当个答题机器，这篇讲的就是怎么让它自己学会调度讨论节奏
articles.author: Ziyi Liu, Tzu-Sheng Kuo 等
articles.body: As large language models are increasingly adopted as multi-party communication facilitators, there is a growing demand for agents capable of balancing diverse group dynamics across contexts. However, existing LLM facilitators are often fine-tuned for task-specific objectives; generalized LLM-based facilitation methods that can adapt to different types of tasks and diverse group dynamics are underdeveloped. To address this gap, we present GUIDE (Generalized Unified Intervention for Dynamic Exchanges, a framework for developing generalized LLM-based facilitators across different multi-party contexts. GUIDE evaluates facilitation across both objective task outcomes and subjective metrics, including psychological safety and perceived friction. Within this framework, we study whether LLMs can self-learn generalized facilitation strategy offline to real-time interventions. We first collect multi-party human interactions guided by task-specific expert LLM facilitators (N=432 conversations). We then employ a self-learning method in which an LLM induces an actionable strategic playbook from conversations and iteratively refines it using feedback from an LLM judge aligned with human annotators (N=20), developing a single generalized facilitator that outperforms the three task-specific expert facilitators on held-out conversations 61.4% win rate. Finally, we evaluate these improvements empirically; in a real-time online empirical study, the self-learned generalized facilitator preserves facilitator performance and group productivity, improves speaking comfort and reduces interpersonal friction, while using 24.7% fewer turns and 29.0% fewer words than the expert prompts. These findings provide empirical evidence that LLMs can learn generalizable, task-agnostic social facilitation from task-specific human interactions, on-par with hand-crafted task-specific prompts across diverse group settings.
articles.bodyZh: 随着大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）越来越多地被用作多方沟通的主持者（multi-party communication facilitators），人们对能在不同场景下平衡各种群体动态的智能体（agents）需求也越来越大。可现有的基于 LLM 的主持者（LLM facilitators）往往是为某个具体任务专门微调出来的；能适配不同任务类型和多样群体动态、通用的基于 LLM 的引导方法，发展得还不够。为了补上这个缺口，我们提出了 GUIDE（Generalized Unified Intervention for Dynamic Exchanges，面向动态交流的通用统一干预），这是一个用来开发能跨不同多方场景工作的通用 LLM 主持者的框架（framework）。GUIDE 会同时看客观任务结果和主观指标，包括心理安全感（psychological safety）和感受到的摩擦（perceived friction）。在这个框架里，我们研究 LLM 能不能自己离线学会通用引导策略，再拿去做实时干预。我们先是收集了由任务专用专家 LLM 主持者引导的多方人类互动（N=432 场对话）。然后我们用了自学习（self-learning）方法：让一个 LLM 从对话里归纳出一套可执行的策略手册（actionable strategic playbook），再用一个与人类标注员（N=20）对齐过的 LLM 评审（LLM judge）给出的反馈反复打磨它，最终训练出一个通用的主持者。在没参与训练的对话（held-out conversations）上，它的胜率达到 61.4%，超过了三个任务专用专家主持者。最后，我们还对这些改进做了实证评估；在一项实时在线实证研究中，这个自学习出来的通用主持者保住了主持表现和团队生产力，提升了发言舒适度，减少了人际摩擦，同时比专家提示词（prompts）少用了 24.7% 的轮次和 29.0% 的词汇。这些发现提供了实证证据：LLM 能从任务专用的人类互动里学到可泛化、不依赖具体任务的社交引导能力，并且在各种群体场景中，表现和人工设计的任务专用提示词不相上下。

articles.title: Look Back to Move Forward: Learning to Revisit for Agentic Compositional Image Generation
articles.zh: 回看才能前进：面向Agent式组合图像生成的学习式回访机制
articles.summary: 如果你的图像生成agent总是画着画着就跑偏，这篇的"回头检查"策略可以直接抄
articles.author: Zixu Wang, Xiaoran Zhao 等
articles.body: Text-to-image models have made remarkable progress in visual fidelity and instruction following, yet complex compositional generation remains challenging. Existing agentic approaches address this limitation through iterative generation and editing, adapting their actions based on interaction history. However, they typically fix the continuation state (i.e., the image from which refinement proceeds) to the latest image. Since iterative editing is not necessarily monotonic, the agent may continue refining from the latest image even when it has already degraded. In this work, we introduce GenRevisit, an agentic framework that extends action selection to joint continuation-state and action selection. The agent can not only use interaction history to adjust editing instructions but also select an image candidate to edit, jointly deciding where to continue from and how to refine. We train GenRevisit with SFT followed by agentic reinforcement learning. To address the coarse credit assignment of final outcome reward in GRPO, which assigns the same trajectory-level advantage to all actions, we further propose Normalized Action Credit Assignment (NACA) to redistribute positive advantage according to each action's contribution to reducing the remaining objective. On GenEval2, GenRevisit achieves GM scores of 84.3 and 74.4 with Qwen-Image-2512 and Z-Image-Turbo, surpassing the strongest baselines using the same generators by 12.7 and 10.9 points respectively. GenRevisit achieves state-of-the-art performance on GenEval, GenEval++, and GenEval2 among baselines.
articles.bodyZh:
文本到图像模型在视觉保真度和指令遵循方面已经取得了显著进步，但生成复杂的组合内容仍然很有挑战。现有的智能体式方法通过迭代生成和编辑来应对这一局限，根据交互历史调整自己的动作。然而，它们通常把继续状态（continuation state，即从哪张图继续优化）固定为最新生成的图像。由于迭代编辑并不一定是单调变好的，智能体可能明明最新图像已经变差了，却还在继续对它做优化。

在这项工作中，我们提出了 GenRevisit，这是一个智能体框架，把动作选择扩展为“继续状态+动作”的联合选择。智能体不仅能利用交互历史调整编辑指令，还能选择一张候选图像来进行编辑，从而同时决定从哪里继续以及如何优化。我们用 SFT（监督微调）加智能体强化学习来训练 GenRevisit。为了解决 GRPO 中最终结果奖励的粗粒度信用分配问题——也就是把同一个轨迹级别的优势分配给所有动作——我们进一步提出了归一化动作信用分配（Normalized Action Credit Assignment，NACA），根据每个动作对减少剩余目标的贡献来重新分配正向优势。

在 GenEval2 上，GenRevisit 使用 Qwen-Image-2512 和 Z-Image-Turbo 分别达到了 84.3 和 74.4 的 GM 分数，比使用相同生成器的最强基线分别高出 12.7 和 10.9 分。在所有基线方法中，GenRevisit 在 GenEval、GenEval++ 和 GenEval2 上均达到了最先进的性能。

articles.title: OneShot: Label-Efficient Detector Weighting for Time Series Anomaly Detection
articles.zh: OneShot：面向时间序列异常检测的标签高效检测器加权方法
articles.summary: 如果你做时序异常检测但标注数据少得可怜，这篇讲怎么用一次标注就挑对最该用的检测器
articles.author: Seunghan Lee, Jun Seo 等
articles.body: Time series (TS) anomaly detection (AD) lacks a universal detector, with the best choice determined by the series rather than by the algorithm. Existing methods therefore either select one detector for each series or average a pool of them. However, both assume that no label ever arrives, while a deployed monitor does receive them, since an operator confirms the alarms it raises. In this paper, we propose ONESHOT, which uses a single confirmed anomaly to weight the pool rather than to choose one detector from it. Specifically, we score each detector on the confirmed anomaly, and those scores become the weights of a soft mixture over the whole pool. We show that a single confirmed anomaly is enough to come close to the best detector for the series. Across 152 univariate and 73 multivariate series, ONESHOT outperforms the strongest single detector, averaging the whole pool, and even picking the best detector on the confirmed event. Code is available at: https://github.com/seunghan96/one_shot.
articles.bodyZh: 时间序列（TS）异常检测（AD）并没有一个通用的检测器，最佳选择取决于具体的时间序列，而不是算法本身。所以，现有的方法要么为每个序列选一个检测器，要么把一堆检测器平均一下。但问题是，这两种方法都假设永远不会有标签出现，而实际部署中的监控系统是会收到标签的，因为操作员会确认它发出的警报。在这篇论文里，我们提出了ONESHOT，它用一个已确认的异常来给整个检测器池加权，而不是从中挑选一个检测器。具体来说，我们用这个已确认的异常给每个检测器打分，这些分数就成了整个检测器池软混合（soft mixture）的权重。我们证明了，一个已确认的异常就足够接近该序列的最佳检测器。在152个单变量和73个多变量序列上，ONESHOT的表现超过了最强的单个检测器、整个池的平均，甚至超过了在已确认事件上挑选最佳检测器的方法。代码已开源：https://github.com/seunghan96/one_shot。

articles.title: SafeDSE: Joint Exploration of Safety Architecture Patterns, Mapping, and Scheduling for Dataflow Applications With Safety Arguments (Extended Version)
articles.zh: SafeDSE：面向数据流应用的安全架构模式、映射与调度联合探索（附安全论证，扩展版）
articles.summary: 如果你在做安全关键系统的数据流编译，这篇把架构模式、映射、调度和安全论证放在一起搜，不是纯理论
articles.author: Fatemeh Bahrami, Seyed-Hosein Attarzadeh-Niaki
articles.body: Embedded platforms increasingly host safety-related streaming functions next to less critical ones. Whether a safety architecture pattern, such as a doer/checker pair, protects a function depends on the cores that run its components. Their schedule must meet the throughput requirement, and mixing safety integrity levels (SILs) on one core raises development cost. This report presents SafeDSE, a design space exploration framework for synchronous dataflow applications. One declarative constraint model decides the pattern of each actor, the placement that the fault model requires, the static-order schedule, and the platform, and prices SIL promotion. Guards activate the chosen patterns in a fixed graph that holds all of them, and node potentials encode throughput. An independent verifier re-checks every solution, and a generator turns its checks into evidence of a safety argument in Goal Structuring Notation. On 9 benchmark instances under period bounds, no rule that fixes patterns before mapping was both always feasible and never more expensive under conservative pricing, while joint exploration was. In the generated arguments, 49 to 62% of the leaves cite verifier checks; the rest are claims a mapping cannot discharge. Optimality within the model was proven for all synthetic graphs with up to 16 actors. This extended version adds the full model, the verifier and generator in detail, the complete catalog and parameters, and a proof of the potential characterization. It also reports every experiment per instance, a mutation analysis of the verifier, and the negative results of the development.
articles.bodyZh: 嵌入式平台现在越来越多地把跟安全相关的流式功能，安排在不太关键的功能旁边一起跑。像执行者/检查者配对（doer/checker pair）这类安全架构模式（safety architecture pattern）到底能不能真正保护某个功能，得看运行它各个组件的那些核心（cores）。它们的调度必须满足吞吐量要求（throughput requirement），而且把不同安全完整性等级（safety integrity levels, SILs）混在同一个核心上，会让开发成本变高。这份报告介绍 SafeDSE，一个面向同步数据流（synchronous dataflow）应用的设计空间探索（design space exploration, DSE）框架。只用一套声明式约束模型（declarative constraint model），就能决定每个角色（actor）采用什么模式、故障模型（fault model）要求把它放在哪里、静态顺序调度（static-order schedule）怎么排，以及用哪个平台，还会给 SIL 提升（SIL promotion）算代价。守护条件（Guards）会在一个装下所有模式的固定图（graph）里，把选中的模式激活；节点势（node potentials）则用来编码吞吐量。一个独立验证器（verifier）会重新检查每个方案，而一个生成器（generator）会把它的检查结果变成目标结构化表示法（Goal Structuring Notation, GSN）下的安全论证证据。在 9 个带周期约束（period bounds）的基准实例（benchmark instances）上，任何“先定模式、再做映射（mapping）”的规则，都没法既永远可行，又在保守定价（conservative pricing）下永远不更贵；而联合探索（joint exploration）可以做到。在生成的论证里，49% 到 62% 的叶子节点（leaves）会引用验证器的检查结果，剩下的则是映射本身没法消解掉的主张。对所有最多 16 个角色的合成图（synthetic graphs），模型范围内的最优性（optimality）都得到了证明。这个扩展版（extended version）补上了完整模型、验证器和生成器的详细说明、完整目录和参数，以及节点势刻画（potential characterization）的证明。它还逐个实例报告了所有实验，给出了验证器的变异分析（mutation analysis），也交代了这项开发里的负面结果。

articles.title: MP-MNCA: Morphology-Prior Masked Neighbor Cross-Attention for Efficient Spatial Domain Identification
articles.zh: MP-MNCA：面向高效空间域识别的形态学先验掩码邻居交叉注意力
articles.summary: 如果你做空间转录组聚类，把形态学先验塞进注意力这招能同时提精度和省算力
articles.author: Sidharthan Sivacoumar Chitra, Sanjeev Manivannan
articles.body: Spatial transcriptomics jointly captures molecular state, tissue morphology, and spatial organization, yet spatial-domain methods are typically compared only at late training checkpoints, obscuring differences in convergence efficiency. We introduce MP-MNCA, a morphology-prior masked neighbor cross-attention framework that preserves the full 3,000 dimensional highly-variable-gene representation while selectively routing molecular information across spatial neighbors, with histological similarity incorporated as a continuous attention prior under a self-supervised masked neighbor-contrastive objective. Across 12 heterogeneous human dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC) sections, MP-MNCA is evaluated against established spatial-domain baselines using both convergence trajectories and epoch-wise spatial-domain visualizations. Our results show that MP-MNCA (i) reaches coherent spatial-domain structure in substantially fewer training epochs, as reflected quantitatively by convergence curves and qualitatively by progressive spatial grids, and (ii) maintains strong clustering quality, achieving a mean peak refined ARI of 0.546 versus 0.549 for the strongest baseline (STAIG), while attaining the highest mean refined NMI of 0.657 versus 0.640. Moreover, MP-MNCA outperforms STAIG on 7 of 12 sections in ARI and 11 of 12 in NMI, demonstrating faster convergence without sacrificing spatial-domain quality.
articles.bodyZh: 空间转录组学（spatial transcriptomics）能同时捕捉分子状态、组织形态和空间组织信息，但空间域（spatial-domain）方法通常只在训练后期的检查点进行比较，这就掩盖了不同方法在收敛效率上的差异。我们提出MP-MNCA，一个形态先验掩码邻居交叉注意力（morphology-prior masked neighbor cross-attention）框架。它保留了完整的3000维高变基因（highly-variable-gene）表示，同时在空间邻居之间选择性地路由分子信息，并将组织学相似性作为连续注意力先验，纳入自监督掩码邻居对比目标中。在12个异质性人类背外侧前额叶皮层（DLPFC）切片上，我们用收敛轨迹和逐轮次的空间域可视化，将MP-MNCA与已有的空间域基线方法进行了对比评估。结果表明，MP-MNCA（一）用明显更少的训练轮次就能形成清晰连贯的空间域结构——这在定量上体现为收敛曲线，在定性上体现为逐步生成的空间网格；（二）保持了很强的聚类质量，平均峰值精炼ARI达到0.546，而最强基线STAIG为0.549，同时取得了最高的平均精炼NMI，为0.657，对比基线的0.640。此外，MP-MNCA在12个切片中的7个上ARI超过STAIG，在12个中的11个上NMI超过STAIG，说明它收敛更快，同时又不牺牲空间域质量。

articles.title: Lüshi-1840: Building and Probing a Knowledge Cutoff for a Classical Chinese Language Model
articles.zh: 《律史-1840》：为古汉语语言模型构建并探测知识截止点
articles.summary: 如果你想拿LLM处理古籍或近代文本，先记住它的知识截止在1840年，之后的它基本一问三不知
articles.author: Alex Liu
articles.body: Language models trained only on text from before a given year are useful for studying hindsight and historical language, but the open collections of pre-modern Chinese carry no publication dates and unreliable dynasty labels. We present Lüshi-1840, a 983M-parameter model trained from scratch on 12,262 books (1.28B characters) selected as composed before 1840. A first corpus, dated by a common heuristic, in effect ended at 1644 while containing twentieth-century material. We describe the re-dating and cleaning pipeline that replaced it and an audit with markers the pipeline did not use, which still finds later material. On the model side we measure surprisal, relative to a modern reference, on annals compiled after the cutoff. For events after 1840 against events up to 1820 the ratio is 1.38 (95% interval 1.33-1.44), against about 1.00 for modern general-purpose models. In a series of 294M models, adding the later court records lowers the ratio from 1.33 to 1.16, and the two models diverge from the 1820s, where the added records begin. The probe tracks the coverage of sources and does not establish a single cutoff year; none of our probes exposes the audited contamination. Model, book list and scripts will be released.
articles.bodyZh: 只用某一年之前的文本训练出来的语言模型（language models），对研究后见之明（hindsight）和历史语言（historical language）挺有用。但麻烦的是，开放的近代以前中文（pre-modern Chinese）合集里，既没有出版日期（publication dates），朝代标签（dynasty labels）也不可靠。我们推出了 Lüshi-1840，一个9.83亿参数（parameter）的模型，完全从零开始训练，用了12,262本书（12.8亿字），这些书都被认定是在1840年之前写成的。最早的语料库（corpus）是用一种常见的启发式方法（heuristic）来定年代的，结果实际上到1644年就断了，可里面还混着20世纪的材料。我们介绍了后来替换掉它的重新定年和清洗流程（pipeline），还做了一次核查（audit），用的是流程本身没用的标记（markers），结果照样能找出更晚的材料。在模型这边，我们拿截止年份（cutoff）之后编成的编年史（annals）来测意外度（surprisal），而且是相对于一个现代参考模型来比。1840年之后的事件，对比1820年之前的事件，比值是1.38（95%区间 1.33-1.44）；而现代通用模型（general-purpose models）这个比值大概只有1.00。在一组2.94亿参数的模型里，加入更晚的朝廷记录（court records）后，这个比值从1.33降到了1.16；而且这两个模型从19世纪20年代开始出现分歧，正好也是加入的那些记录开始的地方。这个探针（probe）追踪的是资料来源的覆盖范围，并不能确定某一个单一的截止年份；而且我们的探针没有一个能暴露出审计中发现的污染（contamination）。模型、书单和脚本都会公开发布。

articles.title: Correct Choices, Failed Sequences: Choice2Seq Benchmarks Correctness Retention Across Output Interfaces
articles.zh: 正确选择，失败序列：Choice2Seq 评测跨输出接口的正确性保持能力
articles.summary: 如果你用多步选择式prompt让模型解题，这篇会告诉你单步全对、串起来照样崩
articles.author: Tianyou Lai, Wentao Yue 等
articles.body: A model may select the correct answer yet fail to construct it through a sequence of local decisions. We introduce Choice2Seq, a diagnostic benchmark that measures correctness retention across complete-answer selection and sequential construction in independent runs on the same problems and candidate sets. Sequence Composition Rate (SCR) measures the fraction of correctly selected items that are also answered correctly through local construction. Jev achieves 97.1% and 99.5% selection accuracy on arithmetic and lexical retrieval, yet retains only 33.0% and 2.1% of those correct choices under serial construction, respectively. Substantial gaps also emerge for StartLux and Qwen, including when Qwen emits characters directly. Restricting local options to candidate-supported characters improves construction, while explicit position indexing improves copying fidelity, even for incorrect selections. These interventions distinguish task correctness, plan fidelity, and output compliance. Matched dialogue-state evaluations reveal that local field construction largely preserves Jev's correct states but reduces Qwen's mean-turn accuracy, highlighting task- and interface-dependent differences. Sequence-level confidence and request-cost analyses further characterize completed outputs.
articles.bodyZh: 一个模型可能选对了答案，但在一步步做决定时却做不出来。我们推出了Choice2Seq，这是一个诊断基准，用来衡量模型在相同问题和候选集上，独立运行时从完整答案选择到逐步构建过程中保持正确性的能力。序列组合率（SCR）衡量的是被正确选出的项目中，通过逐步构建也能正确解答的比例。Jev在算术和词汇检索上的选择准确率分别达到97.1%和99.5%，但在连续构建中，这些正确选择仅分别保留了33.0%和2.1%。StartLux和Qwen也出现了显著差距，包括Qwen直接输出字符的情况。将局部选项限制为候选支持的字符能改善构建，而明确的位置索引则能提高复制保真度，即使对于错误的选择也是如此。这些干预措施区分了任务正确性、计划保真度和输出合规性。匹配对话状态的评估显示，局部字段构建在很大程度上保留了Jev的正确状态，但降低了Qwen的平均轮次准确率，突显了任务和界面相关的差异。序列级置信度和请求成本分析进一步刻画了已完成输出的特征。
